label: Early-mid copy phase (outputs 2-4) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase: never on original-token or <DEL> steps, never at recall_idx 0, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Strongly biased toward long sequences (L=9 holds 58% of mass, L<=5 is almost silent). Within the copy phase it peaks while outputting original tokens 2-4 (absolute t 10-12), with a smaller second bump on the last outputs of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8). Magnitude is also modulated by the current input token (c, w, 2, z have about 3x lift; a, b, d are rare), but no small token set captures it. Within the predicted window it fires on only ~31% of steps, so precision is low; the predicate captures ~78% of activation mass on dev.
